root_cause: Contiguous tile grid slicing without spatial buffer produces 1px boundary seam
proposed_fix: Enforce configurable spatial buffer and reject unbuffered confirmatory splits

root_cause: Non-integer pixel offsets between mosaic grids create ground footprint overlap
scientific_impact: Conflates geospatial footprint overlap with identical RGB byte duplicates
proposed_fix: Formally separate source-pixel intersection from geospatial ground intersection

root_cause: 272 boundary-touching pairs connect 235 tiles into single spatial graph
scientific_impact: Splits are not spatially independent connected components
proposed_fix: Block confirmatory gate; label Z1 exploratory only; require external holdout

root_cause: Single-label rasterization overwrites overlapping polygons with last-rendered index
scientific_impact: Silently erases 63 train and 4 val instances from raster priority ground truth
proposed_fix: Enforce original RLE polygons as primary matching ground truth; preserve priority support separately

root_cause: COCO floating-point vector area differs from discrete raster RLE pixel count
scientific_impact: Causes 87 total annotations across splits to shift size-bin strata
proposed_fix: Adopt deterministic formula Area = N_RLE * |det(A)|; preserve native metadata area

root_cause: torch.initial_seed() does not advance per epoch in DataLoader worker process
scientific_impact: Workers extract identical crop coordinates every epoch; eliminates multi-epoch spatial diversity
proposed_fix: Implement explicit deterministic epoch-indexed RNG hashing

root_cause: 256px and unpadded 1024px crops cut 41.7% to 100% of crowns into fragments
scientific_impact: Network is trained on truncated fragments with distorted centroids; cannot learn full-crown instances
proposed_fix: Implement structured full-crown sampling policy with margin padding and fragment categorization

root_cause: Evaluating raw Stage 0 query slots under unique-cover grouping penalizes inactive queries
scientific_impact: Unfair comparison between F and Q; false claim that queries cannot group instances
proposed_fix: Enforce 4-stage output contract; evaluate comparable instance metrics strictly at Stage 2

root_cause: Random tile partitioning for OOF score calibration shares valid pixels and GT crowns across folds
scientific_impact: OOF calibration scores are spatially contaminated by training folds
proposed_fix: Prohibit claiming spatial independence for historical OOF scores; mandate buffered spatial K-fold

root_cause: Historical test tiles repeatedly inspected and evaluated in development loops
scientific_impact: Historical test set cannot serve as an independent confirmatory holdout
proposed_fix: Gate confirmatory readiness with CONFIRMATORY_NOT_READY; require unexamined holdout

root_cause: G0 merge operator cannot split an under-segmented basin containing multiple crowns
scientific_impact: Misleadingly interprets failure of merge-only grouping as evidence against all relational models
proposed_fix: Formally distinguish G0 merge-only from G1 cut-and-merge repartitioning in scientific contract

root_cause: Ad-hoc execution of training/eval scripts without configuration or invariant validation
scientific_impact: Execution of invalid or contaminated experimental configurations without warning
proposed_fix: Implement fail-closed preflight CLI tool with machine-readable exit gates
